mentions.description: A free third-party preset editor for Universal Audio UAFX guitar pedals, currently supporting the Dream '65 with Lion '68 support rolling out next week and more pedals planned.
mentions.audience: Guitar enthusiasts and pedal owners ("guitar nerds") who own Universal Audio UAFX pedals
mentions.source_excerpt:
Dream Chimp - https://dreamchimp.app

It's a 3rd party preset editor for Universal Audio UAFX guitar pedals [1]. I'm supporting Dream '65 for now, rolling out support for Lion '68 next week.

mentions.name: Dream Chimp
mentions.description: A mobile app that serves as a preset editor for the UAFX Dream '65 guitar effects pedal, offering an alternative to the stock companion app.
mentions.problem: The stock UAFX app for the Dream '65 pedal was frustrating to use.
mentions.audience: Dream '65 pedal owners (guitarists frustrated with the stock app)
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a mobile app called Dream Chimp.

It’s a preset editor for UAFX Dream ‘65 pedal that I decided to build because I was so frustrated with the stock app.
